description.value: Bella Gelateria is an internationally award-winning artisan gelato maker founded in Vancouver in 2010, recognized at competitions in Italy, Chicago, and Austin, and ranked No. 1 in the Gelato World rankings. The Metrotown Mall location is one of five Greater Vancouver outposts serving handcrafted small-batch gelato made from 100% natural ingredients using Italian Effi machines. Cyclists looking for a sweet mid-ride treat will find a broad menu including dairy-free, gluten-free, and vegan sorbetto options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as the Bella Gelateria at 4700 Kingsway, confirmed by the website which lists 'Bella Metrotown Mall #K3 – 4700 Kingsway St, Burnaby, BC V5H 4N2' as one of five locations. The website provides strong evidence of vegan/GF/dairy-free options and delivery/takeout, and the awards page confirms the business is actively operating. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the address (4700 Kingsway) is in Burnaby — may cause incorrect geographic grouping.
OSM address ('4700 Kingsway') lacks unit number and postal code; website gives fuller address '#K3 – 4700 Kingsway St, Burnaby, BC V5H 4N2'.
Front page of website contains apparent SEO spam injection: 'pay n play casino sites' — suggests CMS may have been compromised, though the rest of the content appears legitimate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, multi-location gelato business with a confirmed presence at this address; an obvious treat stop for touring cyclists passing through Burnaby's Metrotown area.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is the Metrotown Mall location (level 1 per OSM, mall kiosk per website). No phone number available in OSM or on the website content fetched.

Packed lunches.detail: Menu is limited to gelato, sorbetto, desserts/pastry, and drinks — no lunch or savoury food items listed

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu page states: 'we have nut-free, gluten-free and dairy-free options' and 'our sorbettos are water-based and vegan friendly.'
